newsitem.title: USA: California police find 30 foetuses in boxes.
newsitem.headline: California police find 30 foetuses in boxes.

text.p: Police in San Bernardino, California on Saturday were investigating how five cardboard boxes containing human foetuses ended up in a field near a highway.

A spokesman for the San Bernardino sheriff's department said the boxes were found on Friday night by two children playing in a field. The unmarked boxes, each containing six foetuses, were sealed with duct tape. Each foetus was stored in a sterilised, plastic container.

Investigators were focusing on the possibility the boxes came from an abortion clinic. However, it was not known if the boxes were left in the field by accident or dropped there deliberately. The field was about 35 miles (50 km) east of Los Angeles.
Police said the children found the first box on Friday afternoon. One of the children told a parent, who called police. When investigators arrived on the scene they found four more boxes.
